resources.string: Every button combination: system, games, mouse mode
The first line of the drawing shows the buttons on the top edge.
Buttons are named as printed on the console. On some clone consoles they sit in other places.
Some Soy Sauce clones (batch 253x) have FN and SELECT the other way round. If FN acts like SELECT, the SD card needs the 253x files: see Experimental/README.txt on the BOOT drive.
Hold on its own: shows the FN shortcuts
Hold about 10 seconds: switches off a frozen console
Hold both for 5 seconds: every button back to normal
Start / stop screen recording, saved to Movies
Hold Select, then press the second button. RetroArch gets these when it is first set up. Hotkeys you changed yourself stay.
FN goes to the home screen and pauses the game. Save first: Android may close a paused game when memory runs low.
Where an app allows it, the buttons are the same as in RetroArch: hold Select, then press the second button.
Quit (asks first if the game isn\'t saved)
The game also sees Select and the second button.
Flycast has no restart button. In arcade games, Select is also the coin button.
These buttons are set up the first time each app is opened. Button settings you changed in an app stay.
Mouse mode puts a pointer on the screen, for apps made for a touchscreen.
Hold: slow pointer, for small targets
